scopeEn: Gachabase 3.4.5 beta · Sunbringer D20699967 / R20699967, other agents and equipment D20694646 / R20694646.

sunbringer.name: 挽昼
sunbringer.statsContext: 60 级／最高突破／核心 F；沿用来源的基础面板口径，含核心固定属性，不含音擎、驱动盘、影画和战斗增益。核心百分比属性单列于核心技。
sunbringer.statsContextEn: Level 60 / Max Promotion / Core F. Source base-panel convention, including flat Core boosts; excludes W-Engine, Drive Discs, Mindscapes, and combat buffs. Percentage Core boosts are listed under Core Skill.

moves.name: 普通攻击：斩棘
moves.description:
点按 【普攻】 发动：
林德薇恩向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成燎源属性伤害；
第四段攻击期间若连点，可以持续斩击敌人；
第四段攻击结尾重击命中持有[残痕]的敌人时，若[愿火]未达上限且挽昼仍为当前操作角色，将消耗目标持有的所有[残痕]，最多消耗3层；每消耗1层[残痕]，对目标触发1次[毁伤]，额外造成范围燎源属性伤害；
第四段攻击期间拥有无敌效果；
第三、四段攻击期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Lindverne launches up to 4 attacks forward, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.
During the 4th attack, repeatedly press to continue slashing the enemy.
When the finishing heavy attack of the 4th attack hits an enemy with Gash, if Wishfire has not reached its maximum and Sunbringer remains the active Agent, consume all Gash stacks on the target, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. For each stack of Gash consumed, trigger 1 instance of Maim on the target, dealing additional area Genesis Flare DMG.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th attack.
During the 3rd and 4th attacks, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

moves.name: 普通攻击：执旌
moves.description:
点按 【普攻】 发动：
艾尔妲向前方进行至多四段的攻击，造成燎源属性伤害；
第四段攻击结尾重击命中持有[残痕]的敌人时，若[愿火]未达上限且挽昼仍为当前操作角色，将消耗目标持有的所有[残痕]，最多消耗3层；每消耗1层[残痕]，对目标触发1次[毁伤]，额外造成范围燎源属性伤害；
第三、四段攻击期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Eldreda launches up to 4 attacks forward, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.
When the finishing heavy attack of the 4th attack hits an enemy with Gash, if Wishfire has not reached its maximum and Sunbringer remains the active Agent, consume all Gash stacks on the target, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. For each stack of Gash consumed, trigger 1 instance of Maim on the target, dealing additional area Genesis Flare DMG.
During the 3rd and 4th attacks, Anti-Interrupt Level is increased and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.

moves.name: 普通攻击：执旌·聚锋
moves.description:
[愿火]足够，且未持有[链齿]、[旗令]、[愿核]时，长按 【普攻】 发动：
切换艾尔妲上场并发动攻击，造成燎源属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动后获得[链齿]和[旗令]。
moves.descriptionEn:
With enough Wishfire and while not holding Chain Teeth, Flag Order, or Wishcore, hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Switch to Eldreda and launch an attack, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, gain Chain Teeth and Flag Order.

moves.name: 普通攻击：掷光
moves.description:
点按 【普攻】 发动：
德蕾琪娜向前方掷出盾牌攻击，造成燎源属性伤害；
招式发动后短时间内，若受到敌人攻击，则可自动格挡并迅掷出盾牌。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Dracaene hurls her shield forward to attack, dealing Genesis Flare Damage.
After using this skill, for a brief window, if hit by an enemy attack, she will automatically block and throw her shield.

moves.name: 特殊技：焚夜
moves.description:
点按 【特殊技】 发动：
切换林德薇恩上场并发动攻击，造成燎源属性伤害。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Switch to Lindverne and launch an attack, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.

moves.name: 强化特殊技：焚夜·曦生
moves.description:
锐能足够时，点按 【强化特殊技】 发动：
切换林德薇恩上场并发动与艾尔妲的协同攻击，造成燎源属性伤害；
重击命中持有[残痕]的敌人，且挽昼为操作中的代理人、[愿火]未达上限时，消耗目标持有的所有[残痕]，最多消耗3层；每消耗1层[残痕]，对目标触发1次[毁伤]，额外造成范围燎源属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
With enough Sharpness, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Switch to Lindverne and launch a coordinated attack with Eldreda, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy with Gash while Sunbringer is the active Agent and Wishfire has not reached its maximum, consume all Gash stacks on the target, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. For each stack of Gash consumed, trigger 1 instance of Maim on the target, dealing additional area Genesis Flare DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 强化特殊技：焚夜·曦生（改）
moves.description:
锐能足够时，在[普通攻击：执旌]的最后一段攻击、[闪避反击：冷焰凝锋]、[支援突击：虔志如初]、[终结技：「此愿，重塑万象」]、[强化特殊技：燃灯·晦尽（改）]发动后点按 【强化特殊技】 发动：
切换林德薇恩上场，并发动三位挽昼的全体协同攻击，造成燎源属性伤害；
重击命中持有[残痕]的敌人，若[愿火]未达上限且挽昼仍为当前操作角色，消耗目标持有的所有[残痕]，最多消耗3层；每消耗1层[残痕]，对目标触发1次[毁伤]，额外造成范围燎源属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
With enough Sharpness, after the final attack of Basic Attack: Flagbearer, or after Dodge Counter: Frostflame Edge, Assist Follow-Up: Unwavering Devotion, Ultimate: "This Wish, Shall Reshape the World", or EX Special Attack: Kindled Light - Fading Darkness (Modified), press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Switch Lindverne onto the field and launch a coordinated attack involving all three Sunbringers, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy with Gash, if Wishfire has not reached its maximum and Sunbringer remains the active Agent, consume all Gash stacks on the target, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. For each stack of Gash consumed, trigger 1 instance of Maim on the target, dealing additional area Genesis Flare DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 强化特殊技：焚夜·长暗终焉
moves.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nightburn - Eternal Darkness's Demise
moves.description:
拥有[链齿]时，点按 【特殊技】 发动：
消耗[链齿]，切换林德薇恩上场，并发动三位挽昼的强力全体协同攻击，造成大量燎源属性伤害；
发动该招式后，点按 【普攻】 可快速衔接[普通攻击：斩棘]第四段；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
With Chain Teeth, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Consume Chain Teeth to switch in Lindverne and launch a powerful coordinated attack involving all three Sunbringers, dealing massive Genesis Flare DMG.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to quickly chain into the 4th attack of a Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 特殊技：燃灯
moves.description:
点按 【特殊技】 发动：
切换艾尔妲上场并发动攻击，造成燎源属性伤害。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Switch to Eldreda and launch an attack, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.

moves.name: 强化特殊技：燃灯·晦尽
moves.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Kindled Light - Fading Darkness
moves.description:
锐能足够时，点按 【强化特殊技】 发动：
切换艾尔妲上场并发动与林德薇恩的协同攻击，造成燎源属性伤害；
重击命中持有[残痕]的敌人，且挽昼为操作中的代理人、[愿火]未达上限时，消耗目标持有的所有[残痕]，最多消耗3层；每消耗1层[残痕]，对目标触发1次[毁伤]，额外造成范围燎源属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
With enough Sharpness, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Switch to Eldreda and launch a coordinated attack with Lindverne, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy with Gash while Sunbringer is the active Agent and Wishfire has not reached its maximum, consume all Gash stacks on the target, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. For each stack of Gash consumed, trigger 1 instance of Maim on the target, dealing additional area Genesis Flare DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 强化特殊技：燃灯·晦尽（改）
moves.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Kindled Light - Fading Darkness (Modified)
moves.description:
锐能足够时，在[普通攻击：斩棘]的最后一段攻击、[闪避反击：潜火渐炽]、[支援突击：不灭热忱]、[终结技：「此行，共赴前路」]、[强化特殊技：焚夜·曦生（改）]发动后点按 【强化特殊技】 发动：
切换艾尔妲上场，并发动三位挽昼的全体协同攻击，造成燎源属性伤害；
重击命中持有[残痕]的敌人，若[愿火]未达上限且挽昼仍为当前操作角色，消耗目标持有的所有[残痕]，最多消耗3层；每消耗1层[残痕]，对目标触发1次[毁伤]，额外造成范围燎源属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
With enough Sharpness, after the final attack of Basic Attack: Thornbreak, or after Dodge Counter: Rising Embers, Assist Follow-Up: Unfaltering Zeal, Ultimate: "Face the Road Ahead, Together", or EX Special Attack: Nightburn - Dawnrise (Modified), press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Switch Eldreda onto the field and launch a coordinated attack involving all three Sunbringers, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy with Gash, if Wishfire has not reached its maximum and Sunbringer remains the active Agent, consume all Gash stacks on the target, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. For each stack of Gash consumed, trigger 1 instance of Maim on the target, dealing additional area Genesis Flare DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 强化特殊技：燃灯·永昼之炬
moves.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Kindled Light - Torch of Eternal Day
moves.description:
拥有[旗令]时，点按 【特殊技】 发动：
消耗[旗令]，切换艾尔妲上场，并发动三位挽昼的强力全体协同攻击，造成大量燎源属性伤害，并消除敌人所有[烬痕]造成一次[烬灭]效果；
发动该招式后，点按 【普攻】 可衔接[普通攻击：执旌]第四段；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
While holding Flag Order, press [Special Attack] to activate:
Consume Flag Order, switch Eldreda in, and launch a powerful All-Wishfire coordinated attack, dealing massive Genesis Flare DMG and removing all Embermarks from enemies to trigger 1 instance of Emberburst.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to chain into the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Flagbearer.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 闪避：相位折叠
moves.description:
点按 【闪避】 发动：
林德薇恩快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
Lindverne performs a quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 冲刺攻击：虚空斩进
moves.description:
闪避时，点按 【普攻】 发动：
林德薇恩向前方进行斩击，造成燎源属性伤害。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Lindverne slashes enemies in front, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.

moves.name: 闪避反击：潜火渐炽
moves.description:
触发[极限闪避]时，点按 【普攻】 发动：
林德薇恩向前方发动连续攻击，造成燎源属性伤害；
发动该招式后，点按 【普攻】 可快速衔接[普通攻击：斩棘]第三段；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Lindverne launches a series of attacks forward, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to quickly chain directly into the 3rd attack of a Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 闪避：空间重构
moves.description:
点按 【闪避】 发动：
艾尔妲发动快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
Eldreda performs a quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 冲刺攻击：虚实逆转
moves.description:
闪避时，点按 【普攻】 发动：
艾尔妲向前方进行突刺，造成燎源属性伤害。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Eldreda performs a forward thrust, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.

moves.name: 闪避：巡征
moves.description:
拖曳摇杆并长按 【闪避】 发动：
切换艾尔妲上场，并进入可高速移动的[掠夜]状态；
在[掠夜]状态下使用摇杆控制方向，松开摇杆则会停下；
发动招式瞬间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
While moving the joystick, hold [Dodge] to activate:
Switch to Eldreda and enter the Night Glide state, allowing her to move at high speed.
While in the Night Glide state, use the joystick to control her direction. Release the joystick to stop.
Character is invulnerable at the moment this skill activates.

moves.name: 冲刺攻击：巡征·影域穿袭
moves.description:
[掠夜]状态下点按 【普攻】 发动：
艾尔妲发动快速的横扫攻击，造成燎源属性伤害。
moves.descriptionEn:
While in the Night Glide state, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Eldreda performs a swift sweeping attack, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.

moves.name: 闪避反击：冷焰凝锋
moves.description:
触发[极限闪避]时，点按 【普攻】 发动：
艾尔妲向前方发动连续攻击，造成燎源属性伤害；
发动该招式后，点按 【普攻】 可衔接[普通攻击：执旌]第四段；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When triggering a Perfect Dodge, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Eldreda launches a series of attacks forward, dealing Genesis Flare DMG.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to chain directly into the 4th attack of a Basic Attack.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 切换主控：一体同心
moves.description:
长按 【闪避】 发动：
主控艾尔妲时，切换林德薇恩上场；
主控林德薇恩时，切换德蕾琪娜上场；
主控德蕾琪娜时，切换艾尔妲上场；
主控德蕾琪娜期间，受到的伤害降低40%；期间受到攻击或发动[特殊技]、[终结技]时，将切换回林德薇恩。
moves.descriptionEn:
Hold [Dodge] to activate:
When controlling Eldreda, switch Lindverne into battle.
When controlling Lindverne, switch Dracaene into battle.
When controlling Dracaene, switch Eldreda into battle.
While controlling Dracaene, damage received is reduced by 40%. If Dracaene is attacked or uses a Special Attack or Ultimate during this time, Dracaene will exit the field.

multipliers.label: 冲刺攻击：巡征·影域穿袭

moves.name: 连携技：「筑万众之梦」
moves.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
林德薇恩发动攻击，艾尔妲协同作战，最终保留林德薇恩在场，造成燎源属性伤害；
重击命中持有[残痕]的敌人，且挽昼为操作中的代理人、[愿火]未达上限时，消耗目标持有的所有[残痕]，最多消耗3层；每消耗1层[残痕]，对目标触发1次[毁伤]，额外造成范围燎源属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
林德薇恩触发失衡连携窗口时，可直接选择林德薇恩并发动该招式。
moves.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Lindverne launches an attack, assisted by Eldreda, dealing Genesis Flare DMG. Lindverne remains on the field afterward.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy with Gash, if Wishfire has not reached its maximum and Sunbringer remains the active Agent, consume all Gash stacks on the target, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. For each stack of Gash consumed, trigger 1 instance of Maim on the target, dealing additional area Genesis Flare DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When Lindverne triggers a Stun Chain Attack window, Lindverne can be selected to activate this skill.

moves.name: 终结技：「此行，共赴前路」
moves.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技】 发动：
林德薇恩与艾尔妲、德蕾琪娜协同攻击，并保留林德薇恩在场，造成大量燎源属性伤害；
拥有[旗令]时，消耗[旗令]转化为[愿核]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Lindverne launches a coordinated attack with Eldreda and Dracaene, dealing massive Genesis Flare DMG while remaining on the field.
While holding Flag Order, consume Flag Order to convert it into Wishcore.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 连携技：「以挽昼之名」
moves.nameEn: Chain Attack: "In the Name of Sunbringer"
moves.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
艾尔妲发动攻击，林德薇恩协同作战，最终保留艾尔妲在场，造成燎源属性伤害；
发动该招式后，点按 【普攻】 可衔接[普通攻击：执旌]第四段；
重击命中持有[残痕]的敌人，且挽昼为操作中的代理人、[愿火]未达上限时，消耗目标持有的所有[残痕]，最多消耗3层；每消耗1层[残痕]，对目标触发1次[毁伤]，额外造成范围燎源属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
艾尔妲触发失衡连携窗口时，可直接选择艾尔妲并发动该招式。
moves.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Eldreda launches an attack, assisted by Lindverne, dealing Genesis Flare DMG. Eldreda remains on the field afterward.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to chain directly into the 4th attack of a Basic Attack.
When the heavy attack hits an enemy with Gash while Sunbringer is the active Agent, and Wishfire is not at maximum, consume all Gash stacks on the target, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. For each stack of Gash consumed, trigger 1 instance of Maim on the target, dealing additional area Genesis Flare DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When Eldreda triggers a Stun Chain Attack window, Eldreda can be selected to activate this skill.

moves.name: 终结技：「此愿，重塑万象」
moves.nameEn: Ultimate: "This Wish, Shall Reshape the World"
moves.description:
拥有[愿核]时，点按 【终结技】 发动：
艾尔妲利用空间扭曲展开攻击，随后发动终结一击，造成燎源属性伤害，并消除敌人所有[烬痕]造成一次[烬灭]效果；

When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Dracaene parries enemy attacks, accumulating a large amount of Daze.
When Lindverne or Eldreda is on the field, this skill can also be activated by switching to the next character.

This skill has excellent parry capabilities, reducing the consumption of Assist Points when blocking powerful attacks.

moves.name: 核心被动：梦现=源质重构
moves.nameEn: Core Passive: Dream Manifestation = Genesis Reconstruction
moves.description:
挽昼发动招式造成的伤害均为锐化伤害，使用防御力作为招式伤害倍率，部分锐化伤害会积累残痕值，残痕值满时，敌人会进入[残痕]，[残痕]最多叠加3层，挽昼发动部分招式重击命中处于[残痕]状态下的敌人，且挽昼为操作中的代理人、[愿火]未达上限时，会消耗目标持有的所有[残痕]；持有[残痕]的敌人被击败时，也会消耗其持有的所有[残痕]；每消耗1层[残痕]，对目标触发1次[毁伤]，额外造成范围燎源属性伤害；
触发暴击时，锐化伤害不受暴击伤害加成，转而计算锐暴伤害加成；若暴击率超过100%且已经触发暴击，还将基于超过部分的暴击率再进行一次锐暴判定，触发锐暴则额外计算一次锐暴伤害加成；挽昼每拥有1%的初始暴击伤害，初始暴击率提升0.35%；
挽昼进入战场时即可回复60点锐能，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
进入接战状态时，挽昼获得[极昼]效果，暴击率提升22%，造成伤害无视目标11%的防御力，[极昼]状态持续20秒，队伍中其他角色或德蕾琪娜为操作中的代理人时，持续时间不再减少，挽昼发动任意[强化特殊技]、[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]时重新获得[极昼]效果；
德蕾琪娜发动[招架支援]造成的失衡值提升50%，成功招架敌人的攻击时，可为敌人积累少量[残痕]；艾尔妲与林德薇恩发动的[支援突击]残痕积蓄效率提升15%，造成的伤害提升20%；
全队代理人触发[毁伤]时，每消除一层[残痕]，挽昼获得40点[愿火]，[愿火]最多获得160点；当[愿火]不少于120点，且未持有[链齿]、[旗令]、[愿核]时，可消耗120点[愿火]发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]；
队友触发[毁伤]时，若挽昼位于后场、[愿火]足够，且未持有[链齿]、[旗令]、[愿核]，将触发[快速支援]；挽昼通过此次[快速支援]换入前场时，将消耗120点[愿火]直接发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]，此效果3秒内最多触发一次；
挽昼发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]、[强化特殊技：焚夜·长暗终焉]、[强化特殊技：燃灯·永昼之炬]、[终结技：「此行，共赴前路」]、[终结技：「此愿，重塑万象」]命中敌人造成伤害时，均可使目标积攒[烬痕]，[烬痕]量等同于招式造成的实际伤害的60%；全队代理人造成的[毁伤]也可使目标积攒等同于该次实际伤害40%的[烬痕]；艾尔妲发动[强化特殊技：燃灯·永昼之炬]、[终结技：「此愿，重塑万象」]的终结一击命中敌人时可消除所有[烬痕]造成一次[烬灭]效果，直接扣除等量血量；
挽昼发动攻击命中普通和精英敌人，或发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]重击命中首领级敌人时，若目标持有的[烬痕]已覆盖其全部剩余生命值，则直接击溃目标。
moves.descriptionEn:
All DMG dealt by Sunbringer's skills is Sharp DMG, and skill DMG Multipliers are based on DEF. Certain Sharp DMG builds up Gash. When Gash buildup is full, the enemy is inflicted with Gash; Gash can stack up to 3 times. When certain heavy attacks from Sunbringer hit an enemy in the Gash state while Sunbringer is the active Agent and Wishfire is not at its cap, all Gash stacks on the target are consumed. When an enemy holding Gash is defeated, all Gash stacks it holds are also consumed. For each stack of Gash consumed, trigger 1 instance of Maim on the target, dealing additional area Genesis Flare DMG.
When a CRIT is triggered, Sharp DMG doesn't receive the CRIT DMG Bonus and instead applies the Laceration DMG Bonus. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a CRIT has already been triggered, an additional Laceration check is performed based on the excess CRIT Rate; if Laceration is triggered, the Laceration DMG Bonus is applied an additional time. For every 1% of Sunbringer's initial CRIT DMG, her initial CRIT Rate increases by 0.35%.
Upon entering the battlefield, Sunbringer recovers 60 Sharpness. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Upon entering combat, Sunbringer gains the Midnight Sun effect, increasing CRIT Rate by 22% and allowing her DMG to ignore 11% of the target's DEF. The Midnight Sun state lasts for 20s. When other squad members or Dracaene is the active Agent, the duration stops decreasing. Sunbringer regains the Midnight Sun effect upon activating any EX Special Attack or Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades.
Daze inflicted by Dracaene's Defensive Assist increases by 50%. Successfully parrying an enemy attack also inflicts a small amount of Gash buildup on the enemy. Eldreda's and Lindverne's Assist Follow-Ups have 15% increased Gash Buildup Rate and 20% increased DMG.
When any Agent in the squad triggers Maim, for each stack of Gash removed, Sunbringer gains 40 Wishfire, up to a maximum of 160 Wishfire. With at least 120 Wishfire and while not holding Chain Teeth, Flag Order, or Wishcore, consume 120 Wishfire to activate Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades.
When a teammate triggers Maim, if Sunbringer is off-field, has sufficient Wishfire, and is not holding Chain Teeth, Flag Order, or Wishcore, a Quick Assist is triggered. When Sunbringer switches in through this Quick Assist, she consumes 120 Wishfire to immediately activate Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades. This effect can trigger at most once every 3s.
When Sunbringer's Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades, EX Special Attack: Nightburn - Eternal Darkness's Demise, EX Special Attack: Kindled Light - Torch of Eternal Day, Ultimate: "Face the Road Ahead, Together", or Ultimate: "This Wish, Shall Reshape the World" hits an enemy and deals DMG, the target accumulates Embermarks, with the amount of Embermarks equal to 60% of the actual DMG dealt. Maim triggered by any Agent in the squad also causes the target to accumulate Embermarks equal to 40% of the actual DMG dealt. When the finishing hit of Eldreda's EX Special Attack: Kindled Light - Torch of Eternal Day or Ultimate: "This Wish, Shall Reshape the World" hits an enemy, all Embermarks on the target are removed to trigger 1 instance of Emberburst, directly reducing an equivalent amount of HP.
When Sunbringer's attacks hit a Normal or Elite enemy, or when the heavy attack of her EX Special Attack or Chain Attack hits a Boss enemy, if the target's Embermarks cover all of its remaining HP, the target is immediately executed.

moves.name: 额外能力：领袖之证
moves.nameEn: Additional Ability: Mark of a Leader
moves.description:
队伍中存在[击破]角色、[防护]角色或其他[锋御]角色时触发：
进入战斗时，或挽昼发动任意[强化特殊技]、[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]、[连携技]、[冲刺攻击：巡征·影域穿袭]时，全队[锋御]代理人进入[众愿一心]状态，[众愿一心]状态下，锐暴伤害提升25%，持续45秒；重复进入[众愿一心]状态时刷新持续时间。

When another character in your squad is a Stun, Defense, or Armorer character:
Upon entering combat, or when Sunbringer uses any EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades, Chain Attack, or Dash Attack: Expedition - Shadowrealm Assault, all Armorer Agents in the squad enter the All Wishes United state. While in the All Wishes United state, Laceration DMG is increased by 25% for 45s. Entering the All Wishes United state again refreshes its duration.

进入战斗时，或挽昼发动任意[强化特殊技]、[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]、[连携技]、[冲刺攻击：巡征·影域穿袭]时，全队[锋御]代理人进入[众愿一心]状态，[众愿一心]状态下，锐暴伤害提升25%，持续45秒；重复进入[众愿一心]状态时刷新持续时间。
moves.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Stun, Defense, or Armorer character:
Upon entering combat, or when Sunbringer uses any EX Special Attack, Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades, Chain Attack, or Dash Attack: Expedition - Shadowrealm Assault, all Armorer Agents in the squad enter the All Wishes United state. While in the All Wishes United state, Laceration DMG is increased by 25% for 45s. Entering the All Wishes United state again refreshes its duration.

moves.name: 核心被动：梦现=源质重构
moves.nameEn: Core Passive: Dream Manifestation = Genesis Reconstruction
moves.description:
挽昼发动招式造成的伤害均为锐化伤害，使用防御力作为招式伤害倍率，部分锐化伤害会积累残痕值，残痕值满时，敌人会进入[残痕]，[残痕]最多叠加3层，挽昼发动部分招式重击命中处于[残痕]状态下的敌人，且挽昼为操作中的代理人、[愿火]未达上限时，会消耗目标持有的所有[残痕]；持有[残痕]的敌人被击败时，也会消耗其持有的所有[残痕]；每消耗1层[残痕]，对目标触发1次[毁伤]，额外造成范围燎源属性伤害；
触发暴击时，锐化伤害不受暴击伤害加成，转而计算锐暴伤害加成；若暴击率超过100%且已经触发暴击，还将基于超过部分的暴击率再进行一次锐暴判定，触发锐暴则额外计算一次锐暴伤害加成；挽昼每拥有1%的初始暴击伤害，初始暴击率提升0.35%；
挽昼进入战场时即可回复60点锐能，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
进入接战状态时，挽昼获得[极昼]效果，暴击率提升28%，造成伤害无视目标14%的防御力，[极昼]状态持续20秒，队伍中其他角色或德蕾琪娜为操作中的代理人时，持续时间不再减少，挽昼发动任意[强化特殊技]、[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]时重新获得[极昼]效果；
德蕾琪娜发动[招架支援]造成的失衡值提升50%，成功招架敌人的攻击时，可为敌人积累少量[残痕]；艾尔妲与林德薇恩发动的[支援突击]残痕积蓄效率提升15%，造成的伤害提升20%；
全队代理人触发[毁伤]时，每消除一层[残痕]，挽昼获得40点[愿火]，[愿火]最多获得160点；当[愿火]不少于120点，且未持有[链齿]、[旗令]、[愿核]时，可消耗120点[愿火]发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]；
队友触发[毁伤]时，若挽昼位于后场、[愿火]足够，且未持有[链齿]、[旗令]、[愿核]，将触发[快速支援]；挽昼通过此次[快速支援]换入前场时，将消耗120点[愿火]直接发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]，此效果3秒内最多触发一次；
挽昼发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]、[强化特殊技：焚夜·长暗终焉]、[强化特殊技：燃灯·永昼之炬]、[终结技：「此行，共赴前路」]、[终结技：「此愿，重塑万象」]命中敌人造成伤害时，均可使目标积攒[烬痕]，[烬痕]量等同于招式造成的实际伤害的60%；全队代理人造成的[毁伤]也可使目标积攒等同于该次实际伤害40%的[烬痕]；艾尔妲发动[强化特殊技：燃灯·永昼之炬]、[终结技：「此愿，重塑万象」]的终结一击命中敌人时可消除所有[烬痕]造成一次[烬灭]效果，直接扣除等量血量；
挽昼发动攻击命中普通和精英敌人，或发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]重击命中首领级敌人时，若目标持有的[烬痕]已覆盖其全部剩余生命值，则直接击溃目标。
moves.descriptionEn:
All DMG dealt by Sunbringer's skills is Sharp DMG, and skill DMG Multipliers are based on DEF. Certain Sharp DMG builds up Gash. When Gash buildup is full, the enemy is inflicted with Gash; Gash can stack up to 3 times. When certain heavy attacks from Sunbringer hit an enemy in the Gash state while Sunbringer is the active Agent and Wishfire is not at its cap, all Gash stacks on the target are consumed. When an enemy holding Gash is defeated, all Gash stacks it holds are also consumed. For each stack of Gash consumed, trigger 1 instance of Maim on the target, dealing additional area Genesis Flare DMG.
When a CRIT is triggered, Sharp DMG doesn't receive the CRIT DMG Bonus and instead applies the Laceration DMG Bonus. If CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a CRIT has already been triggered, an additional Laceration check is performed based on the excess CRIT Rate; if Laceration is triggered, the Laceration DMG Bonus is applied an additional time. For every 1% of Sunbringer's initial CRIT DMG, her initial CRIT Rate increases by 0.35%.
Upon entering the battlefield, Sunbringer recovers 60 Sharpness. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Upon entering combat, Sunbringer gains the Midnight Sun effect, increasing CRIT Rate by 28% and allowing her DMG to ignore 14% of the target's DEF. The Midnight Sun state lasts for 20s. When other squad members or Dracaene is the active Agent, the duration stops decreasing. Sunbringer regains the Midnight Sun effect upon activating any EX Special Attack or Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades.
Daze inflicted by Dracaene's Defensive Assist increases by 50%. Successfully parrying an enemy attack also inflicts a small amount of Gash buildup on the enemy. Eldreda's and Lindverne's Assist Follow-Ups have 15% increased Gash Buildup Rate and 20% increased DMG.
When any Agent in the squad triggers Maim, for each stack of Gash removed, Sunbringer gains 40 Wishfire, up to a maximum of 160 Wishfire. With at least 120 Wishfire and while not holding Chain Teeth, Flag Order, or Wishcore, consume 120 Wishfire to activate Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades.
When a teammate triggers Maim, if Sunbringer is off-field, has sufficient Wishfire, and is not holding Chain Teeth, Flag Order, or Wishcore, a Quick Assist is triggered. When Sunbringer switches in through this Quick Assist, she consumes 120 Wishfire to immediately activate Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades. This effect can trigger at most once every 3s.
When Sunbringer's Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades, EX Special Attack: Nightburn - Eternal Darkness's Demise, EX Special Attack: Kindled Light - Torch of Eternal Day, Ultimate: "Face the Road Ahead, Together", or Ultimate: "This Wish, Shall Reshape the World" hits an enemy and deals DMG, the target accumulates Embermarks, with the amount of Embermarks equal to 60% of the actual DMG dealt. Maim triggered by any Agent in the squad also causes the target to accumulate Embermarks equal to 40% of the actual DMG dealt. When the finishing hit of Eldreda's EX Special Attack: Kindled Light - Torch of Eternal Day or Ultimate: "This Wish, Shall Reshape the World" hits an enemy, all Embermarks on the target are removed to trigger 1 instance of Emberburst, directly reducing an equivalent amount of HP.
When Sunbringer's attacks hit a Normal or Elite enemy, or when the heavy attack of her EX Special Attack or Chain Attack hits a Boss enemy, if the target's Embermarks cover all of its remaining HP, the target is immediately executed.

Upon entering the battlefield, Sunbringer recovers 60 Sharpness. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
Upon entering combat, Sunbringer gains the Midnight Sun effect, increasing CRIT Rate by 34% and allowing her DMG to ignore 17% of the target's DEF. The Midnight Sun state lasts for 20s. When other squad members or Dracaene is the active Agent, the duration stops decreasing. Sunbringer regains the Midnight Sun effect upon activating any EX Special Attack or Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades.
Daze inflicted by Dracaene's Defensive Assist increases by 50%. Successfully parrying an enemy attack also inflicts a small amount of Gash buildup on the enemy. Eldreda's and Lindverne's Assist Follow-Ups have 15% increased Gash Buildup Rate and 20% increased DMG.
When any Agent in the squad triggers Maim, for each stack of Gash removed, Sunbringer gains 40 Wishfire, up to a maximum of 160 Wishfire. With at least 120 Wishfire and while not holding Chain Teeth, Flag Order, or Wishcore, consume 120 Wishfire to activate Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades.
When a teammate triggers Maim, if Sunbringer is off-field, has sufficient Wishfire, and is not holding Chain Teeth, Flag Order, or Wishcore, a Quick Assist is triggered. When Sunbringer switches in through this Quick Assist, she consumes 120 Wishfire to immediately activate Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades. This effect can trigger at most once every 3s.
When Sunbringer's Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades, EX Special Attack: Nightburn - Eternal Darkness's Demise, EX Special Attack: Kindled Light - Torch of Eternal Day, Ultimate: "Face the Road Ahead, Together", or Ultimate: "This Wish, Shall Reshape the World" hits an enemy and deals DMG, the target accumulates Embermarks, with the amount of Embermarks equal to 60% of the actual DMG dealt. Maim triggered by any Agent in the squad also causes the target to accumulate Embermarks equal to 40% of the actual DMG dealt. When the finishing hit of Eldreda's EX Special Attack: Kindled Light - Torch of Eternal Day or Ultimate: "This Wish, Shall Reshape the World" hits an enemy, all Embermarks on the target are removed to trigger 1 instance of Emberburst, directly reducing an equivalent amount of HP.
When Sunbringer's attacks hit a Normal or Elite enemy, or when the heavy attack of her EX Special Attack or Chain Attack hits a Boss enemy, if the target's Embermarks cover all of its remaining HP, the target is immediately executed.

moves.nameEn: Core Passive: Dream Manifestation = Genesis Reconstruction

挽昼发动招式造成的伤害均为锐化伤害，使用防御力作为招式伤害倍率，部分锐化伤害会积累残痕值，残痕值满时，敌人会进入[残痕]，[残痕]最多叠加3层，挽昼发动部分招式重击命中处于[残痕]状态下的敌人，且挽昼为操作中的代理人、[愿火]未达上限时，会消耗目标持有的所有[残痕]；持有[残痕]的敌人被击败时，也会消耗其持有的所有[残痕]；每消耗1层[残痕]，对目标触发1次[毁伤]，额外造成范围燎源属性伤害；
触发暴击时，锐化伤害不受暴击伤害加成，转而计算锐暴伤害加成；若暴击率超过100%且已经触发暴击，还将基于超过部分的暴击率再进行一次锐暴判定，触发锐暴则额外计算一次锐暴伤害加成；挽昼每拥有1%的初始暴击伤害，初始暴击率提升0.35%；
挽昼进入战场时即可回复60点锐能，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；
进入接战状态时，挽昼获得[极昼]效果，暴击率提升37%，造成伤害无视目标18.5%的防御力，[极昼]状态持续20秒，队伍中其他角色或德蕾琪娜为操作中的代理人时，持续时间不再减少，挽昼发动任意[强化特殊技]、[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]时重新获得[极昼]效果；
德蕾琪娜发动[招架支援]造成的失衡值提升50%，成功招架敌人的攻击时，可为敌人积累少量[残痕]；艾尔妲与林德薇恩发动的[支援突击]残痕积蓄效率提升15%，造成的伤害提升20%；
全队代理人触发[毁伤]时，每消除一层[残痕]，挽昼获得40点[愿火]，[愿火]最多获得160点；当[愿火]不少于120点，且未持有[链齿]、[旗令]、[愿核]时，可消耗120点[愿火]发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]；
队友触发[毁伤]时，若挽昼位于后场、[愿火]足够，且未持有[链齿]、[旗令]、[愿核]，将触发[快速支援]；挽昼通过此次[快速支援]换入前场时，将消耗120点[愿火]直接发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]，此效果3秒内最多触发一次；
挽昼发动[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]、[强化特殊技：焚夜·长暗终焉]、[强化特殊技：燃灯·永昼之炬]、[终结技：「此行，共赴前路」]、[终结技：「此愿，重塑万象」]命中敌人造成伤害时，均可使目标积攒[烬痕]，[烬痕]量等同于招式造成的实际伤害的60%；全队代理人造成的[毁伤]也可使目标积攒等同于该次实际伤害40%的[烬痕]；艾尔妲发动[强化特殊技：燃灯·永昼之炬]、[终结技：「此愿，重塑万象」]的终结一击命中敌人时可消除所有[烬痕]造成一次[烬灭]效果，直接扣除等量血量；
挽昼发动攻击命中普通和精英敌人，或发动[强化特殊技]、[连携技]重击命中首领级敌人时，若目标持有的[烬痕]已覆盖其全部剩余生命值，则直接击溃目标。

cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.name: 破晓的希冀
cinema.description: 进入战场时，挽昼首次发动的[普通攻击：执旌·聚锋]不再获得[旗令]，改为获得[愿核]，在勘域模式中此效果180秒内最多触发一次；挽昼发动[终结技：「此愿，重塑万象」]触发[烬灭]后，将快速衔接发动一次特殊的[强化特殊技：燃灯·永昼之炬]，无需消耗[旗令]；该次[强化特殊技：燃灯·永昼之炬]不造成实际伤害，但会直接为目标附加[烬痕]，附加量等同于前一次[终结技：「此愿，重塑万象」]为目标积攒的[烬痕]量的80%，随后消除目标所有[烬痕]，触发一次[烬灭]；挽昼发动招式造成的伤害无视目标15%的防御力。
cinema.descriptionEn: Upon entering the battlefield, the first Basic Attack: Flagbearer - Gathering Blades Sunbringer uses no longer grants Flag Order and instead grants Wishcore. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. After Sunbringer uses Ultimate: "This Wish, Shall Reshape the World" to trigger Emberburst, she will quickly follow up with a special EX Special Attack: Kindled Light - Torch of Eternal Day without consuming Flag Order. This EX Special Attack: Kindled Light - Torch of Eternal Day deals no actual damage, but directly applies Embermarks to the target equal to 80% of the Embermarks accumulated by the target from the preceding Ultimate: "This Wish, Shall Reshape the World". All Embermarks on the target are then removed, triggering Emberburst once. DMG dealt by Sunbringer skills ignores 15% of the target's DEF.

effects.description: 装备者暴击伤害提升30%，攻击造成的失衡值提升5%。装备者为[击破]角色时，发动[强化特殊技]或[连携技]时若自身暴击率大于等于50%，会使全队角色造成的锐化伤害提升8%，持续25秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，该效果全队唯一。
effects.descriptionEn: The equipper's CRIT DMG increases by 30%, and Daze dealt by attacks increases by 5%. If the equipper is a Stun character, using an EX Special Attack or Chain Attack while their CRIT Rate is greater than or equal to 50% increases all squad members' Sharp DMG dealt by 8% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

robin.statsContextEn: Level 60 / Max Promotion / Core F. Source base-panel convention, including flat Core boosts; excludes W-Engine, Drive Discs, Mindscapes, and combat buffs. Percentage Core boosts are listed under Core Skill.

moves.name: 普通攻击：轻奏连音
moves.description:
点按 【普攻】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段的攻击，造成以太伤害。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Performs up to three attacks forward, dealing Ether DMG.

moves.name: 特殊技：万籁与我同歌
moves.nameEn: Special Attack: All Voices Sing With Me
moves.description:
点按 【特殊技】 时发动或当知更鸟发动[登场技：星耀时刻]、[终结技：星辰协奏曲]、[连携技：强音重拍]、[支援突击：闪耀应援]后将知更鸟切换为非当前操作角色时留场自动发动：
高高跃起后向周身发动能量冲击，造成以太伤害；
招式主动发动后触发下一个角色的[快速支援]；
招式发动后若将知更鸟切换为非当前操作角色，或招式自动发动时，知更鸟进入[幕后协奏]状态，持续80秒，重复触发刷新持续时间，同时为全队角色提供相当于自身最大初始生命值2%的[和鸣护盾]，持续15秒；
当知更鸟处于[幕后协奏]状态时，无法通过[登场技：星耀时刻]、[连携技：强音重拍]、[反制支援：不息和鸣]和[连携招架]之外的方式主动换入，被换入时退出[幕后协奏]状态；
[幕后协奏]状态期间全队角色获得[守护咏叹]效果，期间防御力提升，知更鸟初始最大生命值大于16000时，每多拥有1000点生命值获得80点防御，最高不超过800点，该效果在知更鸟结束[幕后协奏]状态后仍保留15秒，当知更鸟的初始最大生命值达到26000点时，上述防御力提升效果达到最大值；
招式主动发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式自动发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate, or automatically activates while remaining on the field when another character is switched in during Robin's Entry Skill: Moment of Starglow, Ultimate: Stellar Concerto, Chain Attack: Booming Beat, or Assist Follow-Up: Shining Aid:
Leaps high into the air before unleashing an energy shockwave around herself, dealing Ether DMG.
Manually activating this skill triggers the next character's Quick Assist.
If another character is switched onto the field while this skill is being performed, or if the skill activates automatically, Robin enters the Backstage Concerto state for 80s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. All squad members also gain Harmonic Shield equal to 2% of Robin's Max initial HP for 15s.
While Robin is in the Backstage Concerto state, she can only be actively switched in through Entry Skill: Moment of Starglow, Chain Attack: Booming Beat, Counter Assist: Neverending Harmony, or a Chain Parry. She exits the Backstage Concerto state upon switching in.
While Backstage Concerto is active, all squad members gain the Guardian Aria effect, increasing their DEF. When Robin's initial Max HP exceeds 16,000, every additional 1,000 HP increases DEF by 80, up to a maximum of 800. This effect persists for 15s after Robin exits the Backstage Concerto state. The DEF bonus reaches its maximum when Robin's Max initial HP reaches 26,000.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40% when this skill is activated manually.
Character is invulnerable when this skill activates automatically.

moves.name: 特殊技：弦歌相和
moves.description:
知更鸟处于[幕后协奏]状态时，队伍中其他当前操作角色攻击命中敌人时发动：
向前方发动攻击，造成以太伤害；
发动时获得20点[星耀值]，并为全队角色提供相当于自身最大初始生命值4%的[和鸣护盾]，持续15秒；
[特殊技：弦歌相和]为追加攻击，每10秒最多可以发动一次；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
While Robin is in the Backstage Concerto state, this skill activates when an attack from another active character in the squad hits an enemy:
Launches an attack forward, dealing Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gains 20 Starglow and grants all squad members Harmonic Shield equal to 4% of Robin's Max initial HP for 15s.
Special Attack: Songs in Harmony is an Aftershock and can be triggered once every 10s.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 强化特殊技：震律齐鸣
moves.description:
发动[特殊技：弦歌相和]时，若能量大于等于40点则触发招式升级，将其升级为[强化特殊技：震律齐鸣]：
持续消耗总计40点能量向前方发射强力音浪，造成大量以太伤害；
知更鸟会根据最大生命值的140%额外提升重击的伤害；
发动时获得20点[星耀值]，并为全队角色提供相当于自身最大初始生命值8%的[和鸣护盾]，持续15秒；
[强化特殊技：震律齐鸣]为追加攻击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When using Special Attack: Songs in Harmony with at least 40 Energy, the skill is upgraded to EX Special Attack: Seismic Chorus:
Continuously consumes a total of 40 Energy to unleash a powerful sound wave forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Robin's heavy attack DMG is additionally increased based on 140% of her Max HP.
Upon activation, gains 20 Starglow and grants all squad members Harmonic Shield equal to 8% of Robin's Max initial HP for 15s.
EX Special Attack: Seismic Chorus is an Aftershock.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

[强化特殊技：震律齐鸣]为追加攻击；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
descriptionsByLevel.descriptionEn:

Continuously consumes a total of 40 Energy to unleash a powerful sound wave forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Robin's heavy attack DMG is additionally increased based on 100% of her Max HP.
Upon activation, gains 20 Starglow and grants all squad members Harmonic Shield equal to 8% of Robin's Max initial HP for 15s.
EX Special Attack: Seismic Chorus is an Aftershock.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

multipliers.label: 特殊技：万籁与我同歌
multipliers.labelEn: Special Attack: All Voices Sing With Me

moves.name: 闪避：摇曳轻舞
moves.description:
点按 【闪避】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 冲刺攻击：飘羽踏音
moves.description:
闪避时，点按 【普攻】 发动：
向前方进行攻击，造成以太伤害。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Attacks ahead, dealing Ether DMG.

moves.name: 闪避反击：闪烁节拍
moves.description:
触发[极限闪避]时，点按 【普攻】 发动：
向前方敌人发动攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Attacks enemies ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 连携技：强音重拍
moves.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方发射强力音浪，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动后触发下一个角色的[快速支援]；
招式发动后，若将知更鸟切换为非当前操作角色，知更鸟自动释放[特殊技：万籁与我同歌]，释放期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Fires a powerful sound wave forward, dealing massive Ether DMG.
After using this skill, the next character's Quick Assist is triggered.
If another character is switched onto the field while this skill is being performed, Robin automatically uses Special Attack: All Voices Sing With Me and is invulnerable for the duration.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 终结技：星辰协奏曲
moves.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技】 发动：
发动强力能量轰击，造成大量以太伤害；
发动时获得1点[重音节拍]，且全队[锋御]角色固定回复20点锐能；
招式发动后触发下一个角色的[快速支援]；
招式发动后，若将知更鸟切换为非当前操作角色，知更鸟自动释放[特殊技：万籁与我同歌]，释放期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Channels a powerful energy blast through her song, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Upon activation, gains 1 Accent Beat, and all Armorer characters in the squad recover a fixed 20 Sharpness.
After using this skill, the next character's Quick Assist is triggered.
If another character is switched onto the field while this skill is being performed, Robin automatically uses Special Attack: All Voices Sing With Me and is invulnerable for the duration.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 登场技：星耀时刻
moves.description:
拥有大于等于120点[星耀值]时，长按 【普攻】 或处于接战状态中被换入前场时，消耗120点[星耀值]发动：
对前方敌人发动能量轰击，造成大量以太伤害；
招式发动时视为发动[快速支援]；
招式发动时退出[幕后协奏]状态，并为全队角色提供相当于自身最大初始生命值4%的[和鸣护盾]，持续15秒；
招式发动后触发下一个角色的[快速支援]；
招式发动后，若将知更鸟切换为非当前操作角色，知更鸟自动释放[特殊技：万籁与我同歌]，释放期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When Robin has at least 120 Starglow, hold [Basic Attack] or switch her onto the field during combat to consume 120 Starglow and activate:
Unleashes an energy blast against enemies ahead, dealing massive Ether DMG.
Activating this skill counts as using a Quick Assist.
Upon activation, Robin exits the Backstage Concerto state and grants all squad members Harmonic Shield equal to 4% of her initial Max HP for 15s.
After using this skill, the next character's Quick Assist is triggered.
After using this skill, if Robin is switched to a non-active character, she automatically uses Special Attack: All Voices Sing With Me and is invulnerable for the duration.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 快速支援：临时登场
moves.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【换人】 发动：
向前方敌人发动攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Attack enemies in front, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 招架支援：音浪回荡
moves.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【换人】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 支援突击：闪耀应援
moves.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普攻】 发动：
向前方敌人发动攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动后触发下一个角色的[快速支援]；
招式发动后，若将知更鸟切换为非当前操作角色，知更鸟自动释放[特殊技：万籁与我同歌]，释放期间拥有无敌效果；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Attacks enemies ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
Triggers the next character's Quick Assist upon activation.
If another character switches onto the field during the skill, Robin automatically uses Special Attack: All Voices Sing With Me and is invulnerable for the duration.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 反制支援：不息和鸣
moves.description:
自身或前场角色即将被部分敌人的控制技攻击时，点按 【换人】 发动：
与怪物进行角力，角力成功后，化解敌人的控制技并造成以太伤害；
点按 【换人】 换入下一人时，知更鸟触发[反制支援]的优先级降低；
招式发动时，获得1点[重音节拍]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When Robin or the on-field character is about to be hit by certain enemies' Control Skills, press [Switch] to activate:
Engages the enemy in a power struggle. Win the struggle to neutralize the enemy's Control Skill and deal Ether DMG.
When pressing [Switch] to switch to the next character, Robin has a lower priority for triggering a Counter Assist.
Grants 1 Accent Beat upon activation.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 支援突击：完美节拍
moves.description:
队伍中其他角色发动[反制支援]并成功化解敌人的控制技时发动：
向前方发射强力音浪，造成以太伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
[支援突击：完美节拍]为追加攻击。
moves.descriptionEn:
Activates when another squad member uses a Counter Assist and successfully counters an enemy's Control Skill:
Fires a powerful sound wave forward, dealing Ether DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Assist Follow-Up: Perfect Rhythm is an Aftershock.

moves.name: 核心被动：复调共鸣
moves.description:
知更鸟发动部分招式时，会为全队角色提供基于知更鸟初始最大生命值不同数额的护盾[和鸣护盾]，持续15秒，角色重复获得[和鸣护盾]时可以累积盾量并延长[和鸣护盾]的持续时间，持续时间最多可延长至60秒，持有盾量最多不超过知更鸟初始最大生命值的12%，每名角色的[和鸣护盾]盾量和持续时间独立计算；
全队角色每次获得[和鸣护盾]时进入[激昂咏叹]状态，造成的伤害提升10%，持续20秒，重复触发刷新持续时间；
发动[特殊技：万籁与我同歌]后会触发快速支援，若在招式期间将其他角色换入前场，知更鸟将进入[幕后协奏]状态，期间知更鸟无法通过普通换入的方式主动换入，持续80秒，并使全队角色获得[守护咏叹]效果；
[幕后协奏]状态下，队伍中其他当前操作角色攻击命中敌人时，知更鸟将发动[追加攻击]并获得[星耀值]，[星耀值]最多可以拥有160点；
当[星耀值]大于等于120点时，解锁普通换入，此时，若处于接战状态，知更鸟可以通过普通换入的方式发动[登场技：星耀时刻]，发动时消耗120点[星耀值]，并退出[幕后协奏]状态；
发动[登场技：星耀时刻]、[终结技：星辰协奏曲]、[反制支援：不息和鸣]和[连携招架]时获得1点[重音节拍]，[重音节拍]最多持有1点；
进入[幕后协奏]状态时，若拥有[重音节拍]，则消耗1点[重音节拍]使[守护咏叹]状态下提供的防御力提升效果及其上限额外提升25%；
发动[登场技：星耀时刻]、[终结技：星辰协奏曲]、[连携技：强音重拍]、[支援突击：闪耀应援]后触发快速支援，招式发动后，若将知更鸟切换为非当前操作角色，知更鸟自动留场释放[特殊技：万籁与我同歌]；
成功[连携招架]时发动[支援突击]后，若知更鸟不为当前操作角色则自动释放[特殊技：万籁与我同歌]；
自身或前场角色即将被部分敌人的控制技攻击时，点按 【换人】 换入下一人时，知更鸟触发[反制支援]的优先级降低，当队伍中其他角色发动[反制支援]并成功化解敌人的控制技时知更鸟将在后台发动[支援突击：完美节拍]；
全队角色每触发一次毁伤，知更鸟固定回复15点能量。
moves.descriptionEn:
When Robin uses certain skills, she grants all squad members varying amounts of Harmonic Shield based on her Max initial HP, lasting 15s. Repeatedly gaining Harmonic Shield allows characters to stack Shield and extend the duration of Harmonic Shield, up to a maximum of 60s. The total Shield cannot exceed 12% of Robin's Max initial HP. Each character's Harmonic Shield amount and duration are calculated independently.
Whenever a squad member gains Harmonic Shield, they enter the Rousing Aria state, increasing their DMG by 10% for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Using Special Attack: All Voices Sing With Me triggers a Quick Assist. If another character is switched onto the field during the skill, Robin enters the Backstage Concerto state for 80s, during which she cannot be actively switched in through normal character switching, and all squad members gain the Guardian Aria effect.
While in Backstage Concerto, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with an attack, Robin performs an Aftershock and gains Starglow. Up to 160 points of Starglow can be held.
When Starglow reaches at least 120, normal character switching is unlocked. If Robin is in combat, she can then use Entry Skill: Moment of Starglow by switching her in normally, consuming 120 of Starglow and exiting the Backstage Concerto state.
Using Entry Skill: Moment of Starglow, Ultimate: Stellar Concerto, Counter Assist: Neverending Harmony, or a Chain Parry grants Accent Beat. A maximum of 1 Accent Beat can be held.
When entering the Backstage Concerto state, if Robin has Accent Beat, she consumes 1 Accent Beat, increasing both the DEF bonus provided by Guardian Aria and its maximum increase by an additional 25%.
After using Entry Skill: Moment of Starglow, Ultimate: Stellar Concerto, Chain Attack: Booming Beat, or Assist Follow-Up: Shining Aid, a Quick Assist is triggered. If another character is switched onto the field during any of these skills, Robin automatically remains on the field and uses Special Attack: All Voices Sing With Me.
After using an Assist Follow-Up following a successful Chain Parry, Robin automatically uses Special Attack: All Voices Sing With Me if she is not the currently active character.
When this character or the on-field character is about to be hit by certain enemies' Control Skills, pressing [Switch] to switch to the next character gives Robin lower priority for triggering a Counter Assist. When another squad member uses a Counter Assist and successfully counters an enemy's Control Skill, Robin performs Assist Follow-Up: Perfect Rhythm from off-field.
Each time any squad member triggers Maim, Robin restores a fixed 15 Energy.

moves.name: 额外能力：重音共振
moves.description:
队伍中存在[锋御]或[击破]角色时触发：
进入战场时，获得3000点喧响值，在勘域模式中此效果600秒内最多触发一次；
全队[击破]角色攻击力提升80点，该效果随知更鸟等级提升，每级增加12点，最多提升800点。
moves.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Armorer or Stun character:
Upon entering the battlefield, gain 3,000 Decibels. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 600s.
All Stun characters in the squad gain 80 ATK. This bonus increases by 12 for each of Robin's levels, up to a maximum of 800.

moves.name: 核心被动：复调共鸣

全队角色每次获得[和鸣护盾]时进入[激昂咏叹]状态，造成的伤害提升11.7%，持续20秒，重复触发刷新持续时间；

[幕后协奏]状态下，队伍中其他当前操作角色攻击命中敌人时，知更鸟将发动[追加攻击]并获得[星耀值]，[星耀值]最多可以拥有160点；
当[星耀值]大于等于120点时，解锁普通换入，此时，若处于接战状态，知更鸟可以通过普通换入的方式发动[登场技：星耀时刻]，发动时消耗120点[星耀值]，并退出[幕后协奏]状态；

moves.descriptionEn:
When Robin uses certain skills, she grants all squad members varying amounts of Harmonic Shield based on her Max initial HP, lasting 15s. Repeatedly gaining Harmonic Shield allows characters to stack Shield and extend the duration of Harmonic Shield, up to a maximum of 60s. The total Shield cannot exceed 12% of Robin's Max initial HP. Each character's Harmonic Shield amount and duration are calculated independently.
Whenever a squad member gains Harmonic Shield, they enter the Rousing Aria state, increasing their DMG by 16.7% for 20s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Using Special Attack: All Voices Sing With Me triggers a Quick Assist. If another character is switched onto the field during the skill, Robin enters the Backstage Concerto state for 80s, during which she cannot be actively switched in through normal character switching, and all squad members gain the Guardian Aria effect.
While in Backstage Concerto, when another active character in the squad hits an enemy with an attack, Robin performs an Aftershock and gains Starglow. Up to 160 points of Starglow can be held.
When Starglow reaches at least 120, normal character switching is unlocked. If Robin is in combat, she can then use Entry Skill: Moment of Starglow by switching her in normally, consuming 120 of Starglow and exiting the Backstage Concerto state.
Using Entry Skill: Moment of Starglow, Ultimate: Stellar Concerto, Counter Assist: Neverending Harmony, or a Chain Parry grants Accent Beat. A maximum of 1 Accent Beat can be held.
When entering the Backstage Concerto state, if Robin has Accent Beat, she consumes 1 Accent Beat, increasing both the DEF bonus provided by Guardian Aria and its maximum increase by an additional 25%.
After using Entry Skill: Moment of Starglow, Ultimate: Stellar Concerto, Chain Attack: Booming Beat, or Assist Follow-Up: Shining Aid, a Quick Assist is triggered. If another character is switched onto the field during any of these skills, Robin automatically remains on the field and uses Special Attack: All Voices Sing With Me.
After using an Assist Follow-Up following a successful Chain Parry, Robin automatically uses Special Attack: All Voices Sing With Me if she is not the currently active character.
When this character or the on-field character is about to be hit by certain enemies' Control Skills, pressing [Switch] to switch to the next character gives Robin lower priority for triggering a Counter Assist. When another squad member uses a Counter Assist and successfully counters an enemy's Control Skill, Robin performs Assist Follow-Up: Perfect Rhythm from off-field.
Each time any squad member triggers Maim, Robin restores a fixed 15 Energy.

When the equipper launches an Aftershock, the whole squad's DMG increases by 9.8% for 20s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers refresh the duration. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

effects.description: 装备者的暴击率提升12%，装备者造成火属性锐化伤害时，无视敌人16%防御力。
effects.descriptionEn: The equipper's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When the equipper deals Fire Sharp DMG, they ignore 16% of the enemy's DEF.

effects.description: 装备者暴击伤害提升30%，攻击造成的失衡值提升5%。装备者为[击破]角色时，发动[强化特殊技]或[连携技]时若自身暴击率大于等于50%，会使全队角色造成的锐化伤害提升8%，持续25秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，该效果全队唯一。
effects.descriptionEn: The equipper's CRIT DMG increases by 30%, and Daze dealt by attacks increases by 5%. If the equipper is a Stun character, using an EX Special Attack or Chain Attack while their CRIT Rate is greater than or equal to 50% increases all squad members' Sharp DMG dealt by 8% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

kafka.name: 卡芙卡

kafka.statsContextEn: Level 60 / Max Promotion / Core F. Source base-panel convention, including flat Core boosts; excludes W-Engine, Drive Discs, Mindscapes, and combat buffs. Percentage Core boosts are listed under Core Skill.

moves.name: 普通攻击：折磨
moves.description:
点按 【普攻】 发动：
向前方进行至多四段攻击，造成电属性伤害；
第四段攻击的最后一击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，触发1次[掣电]，造成原本[紊乱]效果1%的伤害，并额外附加卡芙卡230%异常精通的伤害；
第三、四段攻击期间抗打断等级提升。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Launches up to 4 attacks forward, dealing Electric DMG.
When the final hit of the 4th attack hits an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers 1 instance of Lightning Surge, dealing DMG equal to 1% of the original Disorder DMG, plus additional DMG equal to 230% of Kafka's Anomaly Proficiency.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased during the 3rd and 4th attacks.

moves.name: 普通攻击：失序回响
moves.description:
即兴宣奏不少于90点时，消耗90点[即兴宣奏]，长按 【普攻】 发动：
对前方范围的敌人造成大量电属性伤害；
招式的最后一击命中处于电属性异常状态下的敌人时不会触发属性异常，延长电属性异常状态3秒，最多延长至10秒；
招式的最后一击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，触发特殊的[紊乱]效果[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果25%的伤害，并额外附加卡芙卡2800%异常精通的伤害，[极性紊乱]不会清除目标所处的属性异常状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When Improvised Performance reaches at least 90 points, consume 90 points of Improvised Performance and hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Deals massive Electric DMG to enemies in an area ahead.
When the final hit of the attack hits an enemy affected by an Electric Attribute Anomaly, it does not trigger an Attribute Anomaly, but instead extends the duration of the Electric Attribute Anomaly by 3s, up to a maximum of 10s.
When the final hit of the attack hits an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers a special Disorder effect called Polarity Disorder, dealing DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG, plus additional DMG equal to 2800% of Kafka's Anomaly Proficiency. Polarity Disorder does not remove the target's Attribute Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

descriptionsByLevel.description:

招式的最后一击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，触发特殊的[紊乱]效果[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果25%的伤害，并额外附加卡芙卡1535%异常精通的伤害，[极性紊乱]不会清除目标所处的属性异常状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。

descriptionsByLevel.description:
即兴宣奏不少于90点时，消耗90点[即兴宣奏]，长按 【普攻】 发动：
对前方范围的敌人造成大量电属性伤害；
招式的最后一击命中处于电属性异常状态下的敌人时不会触发属性异常，延长电属性异常状态3秒，最多延长至10秒；
招式的最后一击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，触发特殊的[紊乱]效果[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果25%的伤害，并额外附加卡芙卡1650%异常精通的伤害，[极性紊乱]不会清除目标所处的属性异常状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
descriptionsByLevel.descriptionEn:
When Improvised Performance reaches at least 90 points, consume 90 points of Improvised Performance and hold [Basic Attack] to activate:
Deals massive Electric DMG to enemies in an area ahead.
When the final hit of the attack hits an enemy affected by an Electric Attribute Anomaly, it does not trigger an Attribute Anomaly, but instead extends the duration of the Electric Attribute Anomaly by 3s, up to a maximum of 10s.
When the final hit of the attack hits an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers a special Disorder effect called Polarity Disorder, dealing DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder DMG, plus additional DMG equal to 1650% of Kafka's Anomaly Proficiency. Polarity Disorder does not remove the target's Attribute Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

向前方发动斩击，造成电属性伤害；

Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Launches a slash forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Anti-Interrupt Level is increased while using this skill.

能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技】 发动：
向前方发动斩击，造成电属性伤害；
进入[狩猎序曲]，在[狩猎序曲]下可以连续发动[强化特殊技：暮夜猎曲·宣叙]或[强化特殊技：暮夜猎曲·咏叹]；
在[狩猎序曲]下点按 【闪避】 或停留一段时间，会退出[狩猎序曲]；若通过这种方式退出[狩猎序曲]，且本轮未发动任何强化特殊技，则消耗20点能量；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Slashes forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Enters Hunter's Overture and activates Vital View. While in Hunter's Overture, EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Recitative and EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Aria can be used consecutively.
While in Hunter's Overture, press [Dodge] or remain idle for a period of time to exit Hunter's Overture. If Kafka exits Hunter's Overture this way without using any EX Special Attacks during the current activation, 20 Energy is consumed.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 强化特殊技：暮夜猎曲·宣叙
moves.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Recitative
moves.description:
[狩猎序曲]下，点按 【普攻】 发动：
消耗能量并向前方发动斩击，造成电属性伤害；
每轮[狩猎序曲]最多连续发动3轮[强化特殊技]，保持长按时，提前发动末轮[强化特殊技：暮夜猎曲·宣叙]；
招式的最后一击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，触发1次[掣电]，造成原本[紊乱]效果15%的伤害，并额外附加卡芙卡2000%异常精通的伤害；
招式的最后一击命中处于电属性异常状态下的敌人时，不会触发属性异常；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
While Hunter's Overture is active, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Consumes Energy and launches a forward slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Up to 3 consecutive rounds of EX Special Attacks can be performed during each activation of Hunter's Overture. Holding the button triggers the final round of EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Recitative early.
When the final hit of the attack hits an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers Lightning Surge once, dealing DMG equal to 15% of the original Disorder DMG, plus additional DMG equal to 2000% of Kafka's Anomaly Proficiency.
When the final hit of the attack hits an enemy affected by an Electric Attribute Anomaly, it does not trigger an Attribute Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

消耗能量并向前方发动斩击，造成电属性伤害；
每轮[狩猎序曲]最多连续发动3轮[强化特殊技]，保持长按时，提前发动末轮[强化特殊技：暮夜猎曲·宣叙]；
招式的最后一击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，触发1次[掣电]，造成原本[紊乱]效果15%的伤害，并额外附加卡芙卡2240%异常精通的伤害；
招式的最后一击命中处于电属性异常状态下的敌人时，不会触发属性异常；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
descriptionsByLevel.descriptionEn:
While Hunter's Overture is active, press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Consumes Energy and launches a forward slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Up to 3 consecutive rounds of EX Special Attacks can be performed during each activation of Hunter's Overture. Holding the button triggers the final round of EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Recitative early.
When the final hit of the attack hits an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers Lightning Surge once, dealing DMG equal to 15% of the original Disorder DMG, plus additional DMG equal to 2240% of Kafka's Anomaly Proficiency.
When the final hit of the attack hits an enemy affected by an Electric Attribute Anomaly, it does not trigger an Attribute Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.nameEn: EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Aria
moves.description:
[狩猎序曲]下，点按 【强化特殊技】 发动：
消耗能量并向前方发动射击，造成电属性伤害；
每轮[狩猎序曲]最多连续发动3轮[强化特殊技]，保持长按时，提前发动末轮[强化特殊技：暮夜猎曲·咏叹]；
招式命中未处于电属性异常状态下的敌人时，异常积蓄效率提升50%；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
While in Hunter's Overture, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Consumes Energy and fires shots forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Up to 3 consecutive rounds of EX Special Attacks can be performed during each activation of Hunter's Overture. Continuing to hold the button triggers the final round of EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Aria early.
When the attack hits an enemy not affected by an Electric Attribute Anomaly, Anomaly Buildup Rate is increased by 50%.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 闪避：逐影
moves.description:
点按 【闪避】 发动：
快速的冲刺闪避；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Dodge] to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 冲刺攻击：掠夺
moves.description:
闪避时，点按 【普攻】 发动：
向前方进行攻击，造成电属性伤害。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a dodge to activate:
Attacks forward, dealing Electric DMG.

moves.name: 闪避反击：倏逝
moves.description:
触发[极限闪避]时，点按 【普攻】 发动：
向前方发动快速斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Launches a quick slash forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 连携技：月色协奏
moves.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
向前方发动多段攻击，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Launches multiple attacks forward, dealing massive Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 终结技：致昨日的挽歌
moves.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技】 发动：
在前方制造大范围爆炸，造成大量电属性伤害；
招式的最后一击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，触发特殊的[紊乱]效果[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果25%的伤害，并额外附加卡芙卡2800%异常精通的伤害，[极性紊乱]不会清除目标所处的属性异常状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Creates a large explosion ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the final hit lands on an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers the special Disorder effect Polarity Disorder, dealing DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder effect and additional DMG equal to 2800% of Kafka's Anomaly Proficiency. Polarity Disorder does not remove the target's Attribute Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

招式的最后一击命中处于属性异常状态下的敌人时，触发特殊的[紊乱]效果[极性紊乱]，对目标造成原本[紊乱]效果25%的伤害，并额外附加卡芙卡3260%异常精通的伤害，[极性紊乱]不会清除目标所处的属性异常状态；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
descriptionsByLevel.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Creates a large explosion ahead, dealing massive Electric DMG.
When the final hit lands on an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly, it triggers the special Disorder effect Polarity Disorder, dealing DMG equal to 25% of the original Disorder effect and additional DMG equal to 3260% of Kafka's Anomaly Proficiency. Polarity Disorder does not remove the target's Attribute Anomaly.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 快速支援：摩挲
moves.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【换人】 发动：
向前方发动快速斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Performs a quick slashing attack forward, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 招架支援：支配
moves.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【换人】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 支援突击：独白
moves.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普攻】 发动：
围绕敌人射击后，进行终结斩击，造成电属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
moves.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Fires at the enemy while circling around them, then delivers a finishing slash, dealing Electric DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

moves.name: 核心被动：终焉奏鸣
moves.description:
卡芙卡的异常精通提升42点，发动[强化特殊技：暮夜猎曲·宣叙]或[强化特殊技：暮夜猎曲·咏叹]时，回复15点[即兴宣奏]，[即兴宣奏]上限为120点；
处于属性异常状态下的敌人发动攻击时，将触发1次[掣电]，造成原本[紊乱]效果3%的伤害，并额外附加卡芙卡232%异常精通的伤害，每名敌人10秒内最多触发1次；
卡芙卡[掣电]造成的伤害均视为[紊乱]伤害，[掣电]触发时，会记录本次伤害，并向周围敌人弹射最多3次，每次弹射时，造成较前一次伤害衰减50%的[紊乱]伤害；
全队角色造成[紊乱]伤害时，若目标未处于失衡状态，此次[紊乱]伤害额外计算20%的特殊失衡易伤倍率加成；
若目标已处于失衡状态且此时失衡易伤倍率不高于120%，此次[紊乱]伤害的失衡易伤倍率视为120%。
moves.descriptionEn:
Kafka's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 42. Using EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Recitative or EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Aria grants 15 Improvised Performance, up to a maximum of 120 points of Improvised Performance.
When an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly attacks, Lightning Surge triggers once, dealing DMG equal to 3% of the original Disorder DMG, plus additional DMG equal to 232% of Kafka's Anomaly Proficiency. This effect can trigger once per enemy every 10s.
All DMG dealt by Kafka's Lightning Surge is considered Disorder DMG. When Lightning Surge triggers, the DMG dealt is recorded and bounces to nearby enemies up to 3 times, with each bounce dealing Disorder DMG reduced by 50% compared to the previous hit.
When any squad member deals Disorder DMG to an enemy that is not Stunned, the DMG calculation includes an additional 20% special Stun DMG Multiplier.
If the target is already Stunned and its Stun DMG Multiplier is no higher than 120%, the Stun DMG Multiplier for this instance of Disorder DMG is treated as 120%.

moves.name: 额外能力：宽恕无关慈悲
moves.nameEn: Additional Ability: Mercy Is Not Forgiveness
moves.description:
队伍中存在[支援]角色或其他[异常]角色时触发：
卡芙卡对敌人施加[感电]效果时，该效果的持续时间提升3秒；[普通攻击：失序回响]可延长电属性异常状态持续时间上限增加至13秒；
进入战斗时或队伍中其他角色对敌人施加属性异常效果时，若卡芙卡初始能量自动回复大于1.2点，超过部分每超过0.12点，自身异常掌控提升10点，最多提升140点，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
moves.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Anomaly character:
When Kafka applies Shock to an enemy, the effect's duration increases by 3s. The maximum duration of Electric Attribute Anomalies extended by Basic Attack: Discordant Echo is increased to 13s.
Upon entering combat or when another squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, if Kafka's initial Energy Regen exceeds 1.2, her Anomaly Mastery increases by 0.12 for every 10 of initial Energy Regen above this threshold, up to a maximum increase of 140. This effect lasts 30s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
moves.context: 中英文测试文本对换算比例的写法相反。中文为每 0.12 点初始能量自动回复增加 10 点异常掌控，英文为每 10 点增加 0.12 点。两版上限均为 140 点。
moves.contextEn: The beta sources reverse the conversion. Chinese gives 10 Anomaly Mastery per 0.12 initial Energy Regen, while English gives 0.12 per 10. Both state a cap of 140.

若目标已处于失衡状态且此时失衡易伤倍率不高于137%，此次[紊乱]伤害的失衡易伤倍率视为137%。
moves.descriptionEn:
Kafka's Anomaly Proficiency increases by 77. Using EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Recitative or EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Aria grants 15 Improvised Performance, up to a maximum of 120 points of Improvised Performance.
When an enemy affected by an Attribute Anomaly attacks, Lightning Surge triggers once, dealing DMG equal to 3% of the original Disorder DMG, plus additional DMG equal to 422% of Kafka's Anomaly Proficiency. This effect can trigger once per enemy every 10s.
All DMG dealt by Kafka's Lightning Surge is considered Disorder DMG. When Lightning Surge triggers, the DMG dealt is recorded and bounces to nearby enemies up to 3 times, with each bounce dealing Disorder DMG reduced by 50% compared to the previous hit.
When any squad member deals Disorder DMG to an enemy that is not Stunned, the DMG calculation includes an additional 37% special Stun DMG Multiplier.
If the target is already Stunned and its Stun DMG Multiplier is no higher than 137%, the Stun DMG Multiplier for this instance of Disorder DMG is treated as 137%.

moves.name: 额外能力：宽恕无关慈悲
moves.nameEn: Additional Ability: Mercy Is Not Forgiveness
moves.description:
队伍中存在[支援]角色或其他[异常]角色时触发：
卡芙卡对敌人施加[感电]效果时，该效果的持续时间提升3秒；[普通攻击：失序回响]可延长电属性异常状态持续时间上限增加至13秒；
进入战斗时或队伍中其他角色对敌人施加属性异常效果时，若卡芙卡初始能量自动回复大于1.2点，超过部分每超过0.12点，自身异常掌控提升10点，最多提升140点，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间。
moves.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is a Support or Anomaly character:
When Kafka applies Shock to an enemy, the effect's duration increases by 3s. The maximum duration of Electric Attribute Anomalies extended by Basic Attack: Discordant Echo is increased to 13s.
Upon entering combat or when another squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, if Kafka's initial Energy Regen exceeds 1.2, her Anomaly Mastery increases by 0.12 for every 10 of initial Energy Regen above this threshold, up to a maximum increase of 140. This effect lasts 30s, and repeated triggers reset the duration.
moves.context: 中英文测试文本对换算比例的写法相反。中文为每 0.12 点初始能量自动回复增加 10 点异常掌控，英文为每 10 点增加 0.12 点。两版上限均为 140 点。
moves.contextEn: The beta sources reverse the conversion. Chinese gives 10 Anomaly Mastery per 0.12 initial Energy Regen, while English gives 0.12 per 10. Both state a cap of 140.

cinema.description: 同一次[狩猎序曲]期间，最多可以连续发动6次[强化特殊技]；[强化特殊技：暮夜猎曲·宣叙]及其触发[掣电]的伤害无视目标12%的防御力；卡芙卡发动[终结技]后，接下来发动的6次[强化特殊技：暮夜猎曲·宣叙]或[强化特殊技：暮夜猎曲·咏叹]的能量消耗降低至原本的50%，其中，[强化特殊技：暮夜猎曲·宣叙]的异常积蓄效率额外提升40%，重复触发时刷新可生效次数。
cinema.descriptionEn: During the same Hunter's Overture, up to 6 consecutive EX Special Attacks can be used. The DMG of EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Recitative and the Lightning Surge it triggers ignores 12% of the target's DEF. After Kafka uses her Ultimate, the Energy cost of the next 6 uses of EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Recitative or EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Aria is reduced to 50% of the original. Among them, the Anomaly Buildup Rate of EX Special Attack: Nocturne Hunt - Recitative increases by an additional 40%. Repeated triggers refresh the number of uses.

effects.descriptionEn: The equipper's CRIT Rate increases by 12%. When the equipper deals Fire Sharp DMG, they ignore 16% of the enemy's DEF.

If the equipper is a Stun character, using an EX Special Attack or Chain Attack while their CRIT Rate is greater than or equal to 50% increases all squad members' Sharp DMG dealt by 8% for 25s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

changes.description:
自身或前场角色即将被部分敌人的控制技攻击时，点按 【换人】 发动：

招式发动后，点按 【普攻】 可以直接发动[支援突击：支援之锋]。

Engages the enemy in a power struggle. Win the struggle to neutralize the enemy's Control Skill and deal Physical DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
After using this skill, press [Basic Attack] to immediately launch Assist Follow-Up: Aiding Blade.

changes.description:
[裙裾浮游]状态下，点按 【普攻】 发动：
向前方发动范围攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动后消耗[飞羽]补充[护羽]，直至[护羽]达到上限，每消耗1点[飞羽]，都会获得1点[护羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
在[裙裾浮游]状态下切换角色时，薇薇安会自动发动[普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落]；
在[裙裾浮游]状态下点按 【闪避】 可以退出[裙裾浮游]状态。
changes.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] while in the Fluttering Frock state to activate:
Attack an area ahead, dealing Ether DMG.
After activation, this skill consumes all Flight Feathers to restore Guard Feathers, until Guard Feathers reach its maximum, with each one consumed granting 1 Guard Feather.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
When switching characters during the Fluttering Frock state, Vivian will automatically perform Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension.
While in the Fluttering Frock state, press [Dodge] to exit the state.

changes.description:
[强化特殊技：堇花悼亡]或[强化特殊技：淑女礼仪·翩旋]发动后短时间内，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技】 发动：
向前方发动范围攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动时，回复1点[飞羽]；
招式发动后消耗[飞羽]补充[护羽]，直至[护羽]达到上限，每消耗1点[飞羽]，都会获得1点[护羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
changes.descriptionEn:
Shortly after using EX Special Attack: Violet Requiem or EX Special Attack: Noblewoman - Twirl, with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launch an area attack forward, dealing Ether DMG.
Upon activating this skill, recover 1 Flight Feather.
After using this skill, consume Flight Feathers to replenish Guard Feathers until Guard Feathers reaches its maximum. Each Flight Feather consumed grants 1 Guard Feather.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

changes.name: 强化特殊技：淑女礼仪·翩旋
changes.description:
[强化特殊技：裙裾浮游·坠袭]发动后短时间内，能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技】 发动：
向前突进攻击，造成以太伤害；
招式发动时，回复1点[飞羽]；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果；
若突进期间触发极限闪避，会额外回复1点[飞羽]；
招式发动后进入[裙裾浮游]状态。
changes.descriptionEn:
Shortly after using EX Special Attack: Fluttering Frock - Plunge, and with enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Launch a rush attack forward, dealing Ether DMG.
Gain 1 Flight Feather upon activating this skill.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
If a Perfect Dodge is triggered during the rush, gain 1 additional Flight Feather.
Enter the Fluttering Frock state after using this skill.

changes.name: 核心被动：命运悲歌

descriptionsByLevel.description:
[普通攻击：落羽生花]命中处于以太异常状态、电属性异常状态、火属性异常状态、物理属性异常状态、冰属性异常状态、风属性异常状态的目标时，触发一次[异放]：额外结算一次属性异常伤害，相对于原属性异常伤害的比例为每10点异常精通3.07%/1.6%/4%/0.37%/0.54%/0.16%；
[普通攻击：裙裾浮游·悬落]、[强化特殊技：裙裾浮游·坠袭]或[普通攻击：落羽生花]命中处于任意属性异常状态的目标时，使目标陷入[薇薇安的预言]，每0.55秒受到薇薇安55%攻击力的以太伤害，该伤害可以触发属性异常效果的额外伤害；当目标不再处于属性异常状态时，[薇薇安的预言]结束；
进入战场时，薇薇安获得2点[飞羽]；
任意方式获得[飞羽]时，每溢出1点[飞羽]，则会获得1层[飞羽·盈]，至多叠加3层；[飞羽]不足5点时，会消耗至多3层[飞羽·盈]，每消耗1层获得1点[飞羽]。
队伍中其他角色发动[强化特殊技]时，若场上存在处于属性异常状态的敌人，且薇薇安拥有至少1点[飞羽]、[护羽]不足5点，则会消耗1点[飞羽]，获得1点[护羽]，每1.5秒至多触发一次；
队伍中其他角色发动[极限支援]时，获得1点[飞羽]，每10秒至多触发一次；
descriptionsByLevel.descriptionEn:
When Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering Ether, Electric, Fire, Physical, Ice, or Wind Anomaly, it triggers Abloom: deals an additional instance of DMG equal to 3.07%/1.6%/4%/0.37%/0.54%/0.16% per 10 points of Anomaly Proficiency of the original Anomaly's DMG.
When Basic Attack: Fluttering Frock - Suspension, EX Special Attack: Fluttering Frock - Plunge, or Basic Attack: Featherbloom hits a target suffering any Attribute Anomaly, it will inflict Vivian's Prophecy, causing the target to take Ether DMG equal to 55% of Vivian's ATK every 0.55s. This DMG can trigger additional DMG from Attribute Anomalies. Vivian's Prophecy ends when the target is no longer suffering an Attribute Anomaly.
Upon entering the battlefield, Vivian gains 2 Flight Feathers.
When obtaining Flight Feather through any method, for every 1 excess Flight Feather, gain 1 stack of Flight Feather - Overflow, stacking up to 3 times. With less than 5 Flight Feathers, consume up to 3 stacks of Flight Feather - Overflow to gain 1 Flight Feather per stack consumed.
When other squad members use EX Special Attack, if there is an enemy on the field suffering an Attribute Anomaly and Vivian has at least 1 Flight Feather and fewer than 5 Guard Feathers, consume 1 Flight Feather to gain 1Guard Feather. This effect can be triggered once every 1.5s.
When other squad members use Perfect Assist, obtain 1 Flight Feathers. This effect can trigger once every 10s.

[普通攻击：落羽生花]造成的异常积蓄效率提升35%，每次释放[普通攻击：落羽生花]时，全队造成的伤害提升8%，薇薇安自身的异常掌控提升6点，至多叠加3层，持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间；

potentialLevels.descriptionEn:
Basic Attack: Featherbloom's Anomaly Buildup Rate increases by 35%. Each time Basic Attack: Featherbloom is used, damage dealt by the whole squad increases by 8%, and Vivian's Anomaly Mastery increases by 6, stacking up to 3 times and lasting 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration.
Vivian's Abloom DMG increases by 65%. The whole squad's Disorder DMG increases by 25%.

descriptionsByLevel.description:
橘福福的初始攻击力大于2800点时，每超过100点初始攻击力会使自身的冲击力提升3.4点，最多额外提升20点；
橘福福未使用「虎威」时，「虎威」会自动攻击敌人，并在命中敌人时获得[威风]；
「虎威」命中敌人时，若拥有至少100点[威风]且橘福福不为当前操作中角色，橘福福会围绕目标敌人，发动[连携技：虎釜震煞]；发动时，全队角色获得[虎啸]效果：暴击伤害提升10%，橘福福的初始攻击力大于等于2800点时，每超过100点攻击力会使暴击伤害额外提升5%，最多额外提升30%；
[虎啸]状态下，角色的[连携技]/[终结技]造成的伤害提升10%/20%；
[虎啸]状态持续30秒，重复触发时刷新持续时间，橘福福处于[虎啸]效果中，冲击力提升25点；
橘福福进入接战状态时，若能量不足60点则立刻回复至60点，勘域模式下该效果180秒最多触发一次；
全队角色攻击命中失衡首领敌人时，橘福福立刻获得100点[威风]，该效果每20秒最多触发一次；
[连携技：虎釜震煞]命中失衡首领敌人时，返还4点[威势]。
descriptionsByLevel.descriptionEn:
When Ju Fufu's initial ATK exceeds 2,800, her Impact is increased by 100 for every 3.4 initial ATK above this threshold, up to a maximum additional increase of 20.
When Ju Fufu has yet to use Hu Wei, it will automatically attack enemies and gain Might upon hitting them.
When Hu Wei hits an enemy and has at least 100 Might, and Ju Fufu is not the currently active character, Ju Fufu will launch Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron centered around the target enemy. Upon activation, all squad members gain the Tiger's Roar effect: CRIT DMG increases by 10%, and when Ju Fufu's initial ATK is greater than or equal to 2,800, every additional 100 ATK further increases CRIT DMG by 5%, up to a maximum additional increase of 30%.
While in the Tiger's Roar state, character Chain Attack/Ultimate DMG increases by 10%/20%.
The Tiger's Roar state lasts for 30s. Repeated triggers reset the duration. While Ju Fufu is in the Tiger's Roar state, Impact increases by 25.
When Ju Fufu enters the battlefield, if her Energy is below 60, it is immediately replenished to 60. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s.
When any squad member hits a Stunned boss enemy with an attack, Ju Fufu immediately gains 100 Might. This effect can trigger once every 20s.
When Chain Attack: Suppressing Tiger Cauldron hits a Stunned boss enemy, 4 Momentum is refunded.

队伍中所有角色的喧响值上限提升1000点，[强攻]或[命破]角色发动[终结技]时，该角色获得300点喧响值；
[虎啸]状态下的角色攻击命中敌人时，使其失衡易伤倍率提升20%，失衡结束时移除该效果。
descriptionsByLevel.descriptionEn:
When another character in your squad is an Attack or Rupture character:
The maximum Decibels for all characters in the squad increases by 1,000. When an Attack or Rupture character uses an Ultimate, that character gains 300 Decibels.
When a character in the Tiger's Roar state hits an enemy with an attack, the enemy's Stun DMG Multiplier is increased by 20%. This effect is removed when the Stun ends.

changes.name: 拂晓晨星
changes.description: 全队角色触发[浸染]时，佩洛伊斯获得1层[曜锋]，上限3层，该效果每0.2秒最多触发一次；[终结技：无拘剑势]重击命中敌人时获得3层[曜锋]，该效果每20秒最多触发一次；发动[普通攻击：天光]第四段、[终结技：无拘剑势]下劈时，若拥有[曜锋]，则消耗1点[曜锋]强化该招式，额外造成等同于510%攻击力的伤害，且命中处于[浸染]状态下的敌人时，获得250点喧响值，该效果每6秒最多触发一次；[终结技：无拘剑势]命中处于风属性异常状态的敌人时，强制触发一次[浸染]，重击命中处于[浸染]状态下的敌人，额外造成等同于1000%攻击力的伤害；发动[终结技：无拘剑势]时，使所有同时处于失衡和风属性异常状态的敌人失衡持续时间提升3秒，敌人在一次失衡期间内只会受到一次佩洛伊斯施加的失衡持续时间提升效果，且与同类效果不可叠加。
changes.descriptionEn: When any squad members trigger Contamination, Pyrois gains 1 stack of Radiant Edge, up to a maximum of 3 stacks. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s. When the heavy attack from Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm hits an enemy, gain 3 stacks of Radiant Edge. This effect can trigger once every 20s. During the 4th hit of Basic Attack: Celestial Light or the downward slash of Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm, if Radiant Edge is available, consume 1 stack of Radiant Edge to enhance the skill, dealing 510% of ATK as additional DMG. When hitting an enemy affected by Contamination, gain 250 Decibels. This effect can trigger at most once every 6s. When Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm hits an enemy affected by Wind Anomaly, it forcibly triggers one instance of Contamination. When the heavy attack hits an enemy affected by Contamination, it deals 1,000% of ATK as additional DMG. Upon activating Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm, the Stun duration of all enemies affected by both Stun and Wind Anomaly is increased by 3s. Each enemy can only receive this Stun duration increase from Pyrois once per Stun, and this effect cannot stack with similar effects.
changes.previousDescription: 全队角色触发[浸染]时，佩洛伊斯获得1层[曜锋]，上限3层，该效果每0.2秒最多触发一次；[终结技：无拘剑势]重击命中敌人时获得3层[曜锋]，该效果每20秒最多触发一次；发动[普通攻击：天光]第四段、[终结技：无拘剑势]下劈时，若拥有[曜锋]，则消耗1点[曜锋]强化该招式，额外造成等同于510%攻击力的伤害，且命中处于[浸染]状态下的敌人时，获得250点喧响值，该效果每6秒最多触发一次；[终结技：无拘剑势]命中处于风属性异常状态的敌人时，强制触发一次[浸染]，重击命中处于[浸染]状态下的敌人，额外造成等同于1000%攻击力的伤害；发动[终结技：无拘剑势]时，使所有同时处于失衡和风属性异常状态的敌人失衡持续时间提升3秒，敌人在一次失衡期间内只会受到一次佩洛伊斯施加的失衡持续时间提升效果，且与同类效果不可叠加。
changes.previousDescriptionEn: When any squad member triggers [Contamination], Pyrois gains 1 stack of [Radiant Edge], stacking up to 3 times. This effect can trigger once every 0.2s. When the heavy attack of [Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm] hits an enemy, Pyrois gains 3 stacks of [Radiant Edge]. This effect can trigger once every 20s. When Pyrois uses the 4th hit of [Basic Attack: Celestial Light] or the downward slash of [Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm] while she has [Radiant Edge], she consumes 1 stack of [Radiant Edge] to enhance the skill. The enhanced skill deals additional DMG equal to 510% of her ATK. If it hits an enemy under [Contamination], she also gains 250 Decibels. This effect can trigger once every 6s. When [Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm] hits an enemy suffering from a Wind Attribute Anomaly, it forcibly triggers [Contamination] once. Its heavy attack deals additional DMG equal to 1,000% of ATK when it hits an enemy under [Contamination]. When [Ultimate: Unbound Swordstorm] is activated, all enemies that are both in Daze and suffering from a Wind Attribute Anomaly have their Stun duration extended by 3s. Each enemy can only receive Pyrois's Stun duration extension once per Daze, and this effect does not stack with similar effects.
changes.context: 英文说明修订，中文效果与数值相同。
changes.contextEn: English wording revised. The Chinese effect and numerical values are the same.

changes.name: 普通攻击：疾锋
changes.description:
点按 【普攻】 发动，向前方进行至多四段攻击，造成风属性伤害，第四段攻击命中敌人后，累积一定[流息]，第四段攻击如果成功闪避敌人攻击，本次普攻的伤害倍率和失衡倍率提升至与[普通攻击：烈旋]一致，并额外累积一定[流息]；
第四段攻击发动期间拥有无敌效果；
赛维里安在[普通攻击]期间发动[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]和[闪避：写意]时，不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数。
changes.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to launch up to 4 attacks forward, dealing Wind DMG. When the 4th attack hits an enemy, it accumulates a certain amount of Flow. If the 4th attack successfully dodges an enemy attack, this Basic Attack's DMG Multiplier and Daze Multiplier are increased to match Basic Attack: Raging Whirlwind, and additional Flow is accumulated.
Character is invulnerable during the 4th attack.
When Severian uses a Dash Attack, Dodge Counter, or Dodge: Spontaneity during a Basic Attack combo, it does not interrupt the Basic Attack combo count.

第四段攻击发动期间拥有无敌效果；
赛维里安在[普通攻击]期间发动[闪避]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]和[闪避：写意]时，不会打断[普通攻击]的连击段数。

changes.name: 双份浓缩
changes.description:
赛维里安释放[连携技]累积的[流息]值提升至50点；
赛维里安通过[登场技：清场时刻]入场时，会将招式替换为[连携技]，该招式入场类型不会被改变，且视为非重击，此效果60秒最多生效一次；
赛维里安每次释放[普通攻击：苍风影猎]会获得1层[凭风]效果；
赛维里安的攻击命中目标时无视目标15%的风属性伤害抗性。
changes.descriptionEn:
When Severian uses a Chain Attack, the accumulated Flow increases to 50.
When Severian switches in through Entry Skill: Clear Out, the skill is replaced with a Chain Attack. The entry type is not changed, and it is treated as a non-heavy attack. This effect can trigger once every 60s.
Each time Severian uses Basic Attack: Azure Wind's Shadowhunt, he gains 1 stack of Windborne.
When Severian's attacks hit a target, they ignore 15% of the target's Wind RES.
